title: Cold-start jump back seventy-one hours
summary: An emergency cold restart of the engines to escape a collapsing planet's orbit throws the Enterprise back 71 hours. Spock notes the method could be used for deliberate time travel.

title: Enterprise hurled back to 1969

legs.note: slingshot back to the moment before the jet encounter, to return Captain Christopher and the air police sergeant

method: black star gravity well; return by slingshot effect
summary: A black star's pull flings the Enterprise into 1969 Earth orbit, where it is spotted by the US Air Force. Spock times a slingshot around the Sun to drop the captured airmen back before their encounter and carry the ship home.

title: McCoy through the Guardian

legs.note: a delirious McCoy saves Edith Keeler, erasing the Federation
Kirk and Spock follow to undo the change

summary: An accidental cordrazine overdose sends McCoy leaping through the Guardian into Depression-era New York, where saving a pacifist's life lets Germany win the Second World War. Kirk and Spock follow and must let her die to restore history.
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

title: Historical research voyage to 1968
summary: The Enterprise travels to 1968 on an authorized historical survey and collides with Gary Seven's covert mission to sabotage an orbital weapons launch. The records they check afterward show events went exactly as they witnessed.

title: Landing party lost in Sarpeidon's past

to.tText: Sarpeidon's past: an era like Earth's 17th century (year unstated)

legs.note: placeholder t; the episode gives no year

summary: Hours before Beta Niobe goes nova, Kirk stumbles through the library's time portal into a witch-hunting past while Spock and McCoy land in an ice age 5,000 years back. All three return through the portal moments before the star explodes.
conflict: Kirk's destination year is never given; t=1700 is a placeholder.

title: Sarpeidon's population flees into history

legs.note: placeholder t for the whole population's dispersal into chosen eras
Mr. Atoz follows his family last, just before the nova

summary: Warned of their sun's imminent nova, Sarpeidon's entire population prepared their bodies with the atavachron and escaped into eras of their own past. The librarian Atoz is the last to go; Zarabeth was exiled to the ice age earlier by the same device.
conflict: No dates are given for any of the exodus eras; t is a placeholder.

title: Spock saves his own childhood

legs.note: historical survey; placeholder t
they return to a timeline in which Spock died as a child
Spock poses as his cousin Selek to guide his younger self through the kahs-wan

summary: Returning from a survey of Orion history, Spock finds a timeline in which he died at age seven. He goes back to Vulcan as 'cousin Selek' to ensure his younger self survives, at the cost of his pet sehlat I-Chaya.
conflict: The Orion-history destination is undated; t=-5000 is a placeholder.

title: Bounty sails back for humpbacks
summary: To answer a whale-song probe devastating Earth, Kirk's fugitive crew slingshots a captured Klingon Bird-of-Prey to 1986 and brings back two humpback whales plus the cetologist Gillian Taylor, who stays in the 23rd century.
sources: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

title: Tholian Web Defiant lands a century early

legs.note: the ship crossed both universes and about a century

summary: The USS Defiant, lost to interphase in Tholian space in 2268, was drawn through a rift into the mirror universe about a century earlier. Terran Empire officers seized it from the mirror Tholians in 2155.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
conflict: Arrival date inferred from its discovery in January 2155; the exact emergence time is unstated.

title: Manheim experiment repeats a moment

legs.note: loop: a few seconds replay for the Enterprise-D, the USS Lalo and the Coltar IV colony

summary: Dr. Paul Manheim's dimensional experiment on Vandor IV causes brief time skips in which a moment replays. Data seals the rift with antimatter to end the effect.

title: Picard's six-hours-future double
summary: The Enterprise-D recovers a shuttlepod carrying a dazed Picard from six hours in the future, after an energy vortex destroyed the ship in his timeline. The present Picard breaks the cycle by taking the ship into the vortex's center.

title: Enterprise-C through the Narendra rift

legs.note: its absence from the battle rewrites history into a Klingon war
returns to die at Narendra III, carrying the alternate Tasha Yar

summary: The Enterprise-C falls through a temporal rift 22 years forward, creating a timeline of Federation-Klingon war. Its crew goes back to certain death to restore history, taking along an alternate Tasha Yar whose capture in 2344 later produces Sela.

title: Vorgons pursue the Tox Uthat

legs.note: they leave empty-handed

summary: Two 27th-century Vorgon criminals travel to Risa to seize the Tox Uthat, a weapon able to halt a star's fusion. Picard destroys it and they return to their own time empty-handed.

title: Kal Dano hides his invention
summary: The Tox Uthat's inventor fled his own century and hid the device on 22nd-century Risa to keep it from criminals. It stayed hidden until 2366.
conflict: Described, not shown; exact years unstated.

title: Rasmussen's stolen time-pod

legs.note: the pod's unnamed 26th-century owner visits the 22nd century
Rasmussen steals the pod and poses as a 26th-century historian
the pod returns empty on its preset program

summary: A 22nd-century inventor steals a visiting 26th-century traveler's time-pod and arrives aboard the Enterprise-D posing as a future historian, collecting gadgets to 'invent' back home. The pod returns without him, and Rasmussen is stranded in 2368.
conflict: Rasmussen's exact home year in the 22nd century is not stated.

title: Enterprise-D caught in causality loop

legs.note: loop: the ship relives the same ~17 days until Data plants a clue
the USS Bozeman emerges 90 years after it entered the distortion

summary: A collision with the emerging USS Bozeman destroys the Enterprise-D over and over as a temporal distortion resets time. Data's buried subconscious message breaks the loop, and the Bozeman learns it has been lost for 90 years.

title: Devidians feed on 1893 San Francisco

legs.note: repeated trips; the Devidians harvest neural energy from the dying

summary: Phase-shifted aliens from Devidia II use a time portal to prey on cholera victims in 1893 San Francisco. The Enterprise-D destroys the portal to end the harvest.

title: Data's head in a Frisco cavern

legs.note: Data follows the Devidians
Picard, Riker, Troi, Crusher and La Forge follow to retrieve him
away team and a stowaway Samuel Clemens return; Picard stays behind
Clemens goes home
Picard returns last

summary: Data's 500-year-old head is dug up in San Francisco, and he duly travels back to 1893, where he is decapitated and his head is buried. His crewmates follow, meet the young Guinan, and bring back a curious Samuel Clemens, who returns home soon after.

title: Q replays Picard's reckless youth

legs.note: Picard's consciousness in his younger body, days before the Nausicaan fight
without the stabbing, he returns as an unremarkable junior lieutenant
he asks to go back and provokes the fight after all

summary: As Picard lies near death, Q lets him relive the day he was stabbed through the heart. Avoiding the fight produces a timid career as a lieutenant, so Picard chooses to take the blade again.
conflict: Q leaves it open whether any of this was real or a near-death experience.

title: Time runs backward at a warp breach

legs.note: local time reversal around the Enterprise and a Romulan warbird

method: temporal fragments around a Romulan artificial quantum singularity
summary: Returning by runabout, Picard's team finds the Enterprise frozen mid-way through a warp core breach, part of a zone of broken time created by alien life nesting in a Romulan singularity. Time runs backward to before the breach, and Picard severs the power beam behind it.

title: K'mtar comes back as Alexander

legs.note: presumed return

summary: An adult Alexander, whose father was murdered in his timeline, comes back under the name K'mtar to push his younger self toward the warrior path. Worf accepts his son as he is, leaving the future open.

title: Picard shifts across three eras

legs.note: repeated shifts among the three eras
Q shows Picard the moment life fails to form

summary: Q's final test sends Picard's consciousness among 2364, 2370 and a possible 2395, where anti-time spreading from the Devron system threatens to stop life from ever beginning on Earth. Three Enterprises collapse the anomaly together.

title: Two captains leave the Nexus

legs.note: Kirk is swept into the Nexus in 2293 and chooses to leave it in 2371
Picard exits the Nexus just before the Veridian star is destroyed

summary: Inside the timeless Nexus, Picard recruits a Kirk lost there since 2293, and both leave at a moment of their choosing, before Soran destroys the Veridian star. They stop the launch; Kirk dies on Veridian III.

title: Borg sphere strikes first contact

legs.note: Earth's history becomes an assimilated timeline in 2373

summary: Beaten at Sector 001, a Borg sphere opens a temporal vortex to the day before Zefram Cochrane's warp flight, to assimilate a defenseless Earth. The present instantly becomes a Borg world.

title: Enterprise-E follows to 2063

legs.note: shielded in the vortex's wake, the ship follows

summary: Protected by the vortex's wake, the Enterprise-E follows the Borg back, destroys the sphere, repels a Borg takeover of the ship, and ensures Cochrane's flight and the Vulcan landing happen on schedule.
conflict: Maj'el later cites the Cochrane flight as a predestination paradox involving Starfleet (PRO 'Who Saves the Saviors').

title: Sisko becomes Gabriel Bell

legs.note: Bell's death erases Starfleet above them in 2371

method: transporter malfunction (chroniton particles in the Defiant's cloak)
summary: A chroniton-tainted transport strands three officers in 2024 San Francisco, where Gabriel Bell is killed before the riots that bear his name. Sisko takes Bell's place and his photograph ends up in the history files.

title: Kira and O'Brien sweep the decades

legs.note: returns with the stranded officers

summary: With only enough chroniton particles for a handful of attempts, Kira and O'Brien beam down to 1930, 1967 and 2048 before finding their stranded crewmates in 2024.

title: O'Brien glimpses DS9's destruction

legs.note: sees the station destroyed by the Romulans
a future O'Brien replaces his dead present self

method: temporal displacement (radiation exposure plus a cloaked warbird's singularity)
summary: Radiation exposure near a cloaked Romulan warbird's singularity makes O'Brien skip hours into the future, where he sees himself die and the station explode. The O'Brien who remains is the one from a few hours later, who uses what he saw to prevent the attack.

title: Sisko anchored to Jake's future

legs.note: Jake's death breaks the link and Sisko snaps back to the accident

summary: Thrown out of time in an engineering accident, Sisko reappears at intervals of years, tethered to his son. An aged Jake ends his own life to cut the tether, returning his father to the moment of the accident.

title: Ferengi crash at Roswell

legs.note: kemocite reaction with an atomic test blast

method: warp field time warp (sabotaged warp core, kemocite)
summary: Sabotage flings Quark's shuttle from its trip to Earth into 1947, making its passengers the aliens of the Roswell incident. They escape by pairing their kemocite with a nuclear test blast.

title: Prophets send Akorem Laan forward

legs.note: returned to finish his poem

summary: A legendary Bajoran poet lost two centuries earlier emerges from the wormhole claiming to be the Emissary. Sisko asks the Prophets to send him home, where he completes the poem that history already knew.

title: Defiant to Space Station K-7

legs.note: carried by the Orb of Time

summary: Disguised as a human trader, Arne Darvin hijacks the Orb of Time aboard the Defiant to reach 2268 and plant a tribble bomb meant for Kirk. Sisko's crew trails him through the original Enterprise's tribble crisis and removes the bomb.

title: Defiant's descendants on Gaia

legs.note: in the original loop the Defiant crashes and its crew founds Gaia

summary: A barrier planet's energy would throw the Defiant 200 years back, where its stranded crew would found a colony of 8,000 descendants. An elder Odo alters the escape course, the ship gets through safely, and Gaia never exists.

title: Kira visits her mother's Terok Nor
summary: Kira uses the Orb of Time to see whether Dukat's claims about her mother, Meru, are true. She finds them true, nearly assassinates both, and relents.
sources: Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night (episode)

title: Molly O'Brien lost three centuries

legs.note: a feral 18-year-old Molly is retrieved
her parents send her back, arriving just after her younger self
older Molly sends young Molly home and vanishes

summary: Eight-year-old Molly falls through an ancient time portal and is recovered as a feral adult. Sent back through, the older Molly pushes her younger self home and erases her own life.

title: Cusak's distress call three years displaced

legs.note: time-displaced communication, not travel
the Defiant's replies reach her own time

summary: The Defiant's crew talks for days with a stranded captain, not realizing that their signals are crossing three years. They arrive to find she died long ago.

title: Voyager caught in a singularity's echo

legs.note: event-horizon time distortion produces a duplicate Voyager image

method: event horizon of a quantum singularity
summary: Trapped behind a quantum singularity's event horizon, Voyager chases a mirror image of itself that is really a time-shifted reflection. Janeway and Torres find the real exit.
conflict: Memory Alpha lists this as a short backward jump; on screen it plays as time and space distortion rather than clear travel.

title: Janeway and Paris on doomsday's eve

legs.note: their rescue attempt caused the explosion; closing the fracture erases the whole episode

summary: Subspace fractures carry Janeway and Paris to the day before a polaric explosion destroys a planet. It emerges that Voyager's own rescue caused the blast, and collapsing the fracture resets events so it never happens.

title: Micro-wormhole to a 2351 Romulan

legs.note: test cylinder
Telek R'Mor beamed aboard Voyager
R'Mor returned to his own time with the crew's messages

summary: A micro-wormhole to the Alpha Quadrant links Voyager with a Romulan scientist who turns out to live 20 years in the past. He agrees to deliver the crew's letters in 2371, but dies in 2367 before he can.

title: Quinn hides Voyager at the Big Bang

legs.note: Quinn hides Voyager at the beginning of the universe
Q pursues

summary: The Q prisoner Quinn, seeking asylum, hides Voyager at the Big Bang during a chase with Q. The pursuit ends with an asylum hearing aboard ship.
conflict: The universe's age is never stated on screen; t=-1.38e10 uses the real-world estimate.

title: Braxton's Aeon attacks Voyager

legs.note: Braxton tries to destroy Voyager, blaming it for a future explosion
the Aeon crashes on Earth; Henry Starling finds it and Braxton lives as a vagrant for 30 years

summary: A 29th-century timeship attacks Voyager to prevent a disaster Braxton blames on it. Both ships fall into the rift, the Aeon crashes in 1967, and Henry Starling builds his computer empire from its technology.

title: Voyager stranded in 1996 Los Angeles

legs.note: a Braxton from the repaired timeline comes to collect Voyager
returned to the Delta Quadrant, not the Alpha

summary: Voyager arrives in 1996 and must stop Starling from flying the stolen timeship to the future, where it would cause the explosion Braxton feared. Once history is fixed, an unaware Braxton returns them to 2373 in the Delta Quadrant.

title: Kes lives her life backward

legs.note: year unstated; estimated
before she joined Voyager
the Doctor's chroniton-free chamber pulls her back

method: chroniton radiation reactivated by a bio-temporal chamber
summary: In a future where she married Tom Paris, a dying Kes starts jumping backward through her own life, a delayed effect of Krenim chroniton radiation. Knowledge from the jumps lets the Doctor stabilize her, and she wakes in 2373 knowing what will happen.
conflict: Several jumps are dated only relatively on screen; those legs use estimated t values (see leg notes).

title: Krenim weapon ship erases itself

to.tText: the 2170s (before the weapon ship was built)

legs.note: the ship's destruction unmakes two centuries of its temporal incursions; Voyager resets to March 16, 2374

summary: For two centuries Annorax's weapon ship erased whole species from history to rebuild the Krenim Imperium and bring back his wife. When Voyager rams it, the ship erases itself: the incursions never happened, and Voyager's year of hell never begins.

title: Kim rewrites Voyager's fatal crash

legs.note: corrected slipstream phase variance and a message sent via Borg temporal transmitter, not travel

summary: Fifteen years after a slipstream accident killed everyone aboard Voyager, Kim and Chakotay steal the Delta Flyer and send corrective data back to Seven of Nine. The ship survives, and their future is erased.

title: Seven hunts a saboteur through time

legs.note: Seven is recruited at the moment Voyager explodes
Seven searches for the planted device
an older, deranged Braxton
a different Seven and Janeway taken aboard the Relativity
Janeway pursues the saboteur
Janeway returns with the arrested Braxton
Janeway and Seven sent home before the explosion

summary: The 29th-century timeship Relativity recruits Seven to find who planted a temporal disruptor aboard Voyager. The culprit is a future Braxton taking revenge on Janeway, and three versions of Braxton are involved before the device is removed.

title: Aged Kes returns for her youth

legs.note: an older, embittered Kes sabotages Voyager for the Vidiians
implied: she is next seen in 2376, being sent home to Ocampa

method: psychokinetic power boosted by Voyager's warp core
summary: An older, embittered Kes uses Voyager's warp core to go back to 2371 and take her younger self home. A holo-message recorded by the young Kes warns Janeway in time and later reminds the older Kes who she was.

title: Voyager splintered into temporal fragments

legs.note: Kim, Torres and Ayala cross fragments
Seven of Nine crosses fragments
adult Icheb and Naomi Wildman from a 2394 fragment

method: temporal rift (ship fractured into time zones)
summary: A temporal rift splits Voyager into fragments from different years. Chakotay, the only one inoculated against the shift, crosses them with a 2371 Janeway to set a chroniton torpedo, while Seska and the Kazon hold one section.

title: Admiral Janeway brings Voyager home early

legs.note: she dies in the Borg Queen's unicomplex

summary: In a 2404 where Voyager took 23 years to get home, Admiral Janeway buys a chrono deflector and returns to 2378 with future armor and weapons. She gets Voyager home through a Borg transwarp hub and cripples the Collective.

title: Q junior traps Voyager in a loop

legs.note: loop: the same 30 seconds repeat

summary: Q's delinquent son amuses himself by trapping Voyager's crew in a 30-second causality loop, one of the pranks that lead his father to strip his powers for a probation.

title: Future Guy briefs the Cabal

legs.note: orders the Paraagan II frame-up
tells Archer the Xindi are behind the attack on Earth
orders Silik to stow away for 1944

method: partial materialization through a Suliban temporal chamber (communication only)
summary: The unseen benefactor of the Suliban Cabal speaks from the 28th century through a temporal chamber, sending orders and technology. He cannot travel physically, and his identity is never revealed.
conflict: The 28th-century origin rests on Archer's line in 'Storm Front, Part II'.

title: Daniels embedded aboard NX-01

legs.note: posing as a steward from launch

summary: A 31st-century temporal agent serves as a crewman aboard Earth's first warp-five ship to watch the Temporal Cold War. He reveals himself to Archer when the Suliban come for his temporal observatory.

title: Time tourists watch the pyramids rise

legs.note: shown to Archer as an example of sanctioned observation

summary: Daniels tells Archer that time-traveling anthropologists from 2769 watched the Great Pyramids being built. He offers it as an example of sanctioned travel under the Temporal Accords.
conflict: The pyramid-building date (c. 2560 BCE) is real-world history, not stated in dialogue.

title: Daniels hides Archer in the 31st century

legs.note: a private briefing out of the Suliban's reach
Archer's absence from history leaves the 31st century in ruins
retrieved through a Suliban temporal chamber

summary: To shield him from the Cabal, Daniels pulls Archer into the 31st century, but Archer's absence from the 22nd century wipes Daniels' era out. Archer reaches his crew from the ruins, and a device planted in the Cabal's temporal chamber brings him home.
conflict: Memory Alpha's time travel table places the ten-months-earlier stop in 2152; ten months before February 2152 is April 2151.

title: 31st-century pod adrift in 2152

legs.note: wrecked with its human pilot dead
its temporal radiation throws Tucker and Reed into repeating distortions
the reactivated beacon calls it home

summary: Enterprise finds a derelict timeship, bigger inside than out, with a human pilot, and fights off both Suliban and Tholians who want it. When Tucker reactivates its temporal beacon, the pod vanishes back to its own era.

title: Xindi-Reptilians brew a plague in 2004

legs.note: Archer brings Commander Damron back as a prisoner

summary: Xindi-Reptilians go back to 2004 Detroit to cultivate a bio-weapon from kidnapped humans, meant to wipe out humanity before it reached space. Archer and T'Pol wreck the lab.

title: Archer and T'Pol to Detroit
summary: Unable to go himself, Daniels sends Archer and T'Pol to 2004 to stop the Reptilians' bio-weapon lab. They destroy it with help from a reluctant local accomplice.

title: Archer sees the Battle of Procyon V

legs.note: aboard the USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-J)

summary: Daniels takes Archer to the Enterprise-J to show a 26th-century Federation fighting the Sphere-Builders at Procyon V. The point is to persuade him not to die destroying the Xindi weapon.

title: Lorian's Enterprise meets its past

legs.note: in Lorian's history the corridor throws Enterprise back 117 years
loop closes: the ship lives 117 years forward to meet itself at the corridor

method: subspace corridor destabilized by the impulse wake
summary: At the corridor, Archer meets a second Enterprise commanded by Lorian, Tucker and T'Pol's son, whose crew descends from an Enterprise this same transit threw back to 2037. Archer's ship gets through safely and Lorian's never emerges.
conflict: The ending leaves open whether Lorian's ship was erased; Archer and T'Pol disagree.

title: Archer's lost dozen years undone

legs.note: loop/collapse: parasites existing across Archer's timeline are destroyed in 2165, erasing the 2153-2165 future

summary: Interspatial parasites leave Archer unable to form new memories, and without his command Earth falls to the Xindi by 2165. Because the parasites exist across his whole timeline, destroying them in 2165 erases that future back to the moment of infection.

title: Archer glimpses the Federation's founding
summary: Daniels takes Archer to watch the Federation Charter being signed in 2161, to show him how central he is to history.

title: Na'kuhl flee into Nazi 1944

legs.note: one-way stealth time travel

method: stealth time travel (one-way); temporal conduit under construction
summary: Nearly captured by the temporal agents, Vosk's Na'kuhl escape to a 1944 already bent by many factions' incursions. They ally with the Nazis to build a conduit home, from which they would start the Temporal War.

title: Enterprise sent to stop Vosk

legs.note: Daniels' last intervention
the conduit's destruction resets the timeline

summary: Daniels, dying from the chaos of the Temporal War, sends Enterprise into the altered 1944. With the American resistance and a self-serving Silik, Archer destroys the Na'kuhl compound as Vosk enters the conduit, and history resets.

title: Na'kuhl try to stop Suliban sentience

to.tText: before the Suliban became sentient (date unstated)

legs.note: placeholder t; temporal agents intervened

summary: Vosk says that his people once went back to keep the Suliban from ever becoming sentient, and that opposing temporal agents stopped them.
conflict: Described, not shown; the destination date is a placeholder.

title: Narada falls into 2233

legs.note: Nero destroys the USS Kelvin and the Kelvin timeline begins
Spock's Jellyfish arrives 25 years later and is captured

summary: Spock's red-matter black hole, meant to swallow the Hobus supernova, pulls in Nero's mining ship and deposits it in 2233, where its attack on the USS Kelvin splits off a new reality. Spock emerges 25 years later into Nero's hands.

title: Kelvin-timeline soldier crosses into prime

legs.note: crossed both time and dimensions

summary: Lieutenant Commander Yor, a Betelgeusian officer from the Kelvin reality, crossed both universes and centuries as a 'time soldier', and the strain was incurable. Kovich cites his case, which ended in euthanasia, when Georgiou falls ill.
conflict: Arrival year only bounded (post-Temporal Accord, pre-3189); t=3100 is an estimate.

title: Mudd's thirty-minute time loop

legs.note: loop: ~30 minutes repeated dozens of times

summary: Harry Mudd uses a time crystal device to loop half an hour again and again, trying to seize Discovery's spore drive for the Klingons. Stamets, who stays aware across the resets, helps the crew outwit him.
sources: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad (episode)

title: Discovery overshoots by nine months
summary: Leaving the mirror universe, Discovery's spore jump returns it home nine months after it vanished, by which point the Klingons are winning the war.
sources: The War Without, The War Within (episode)

title: Gabrielle Burnham escapes 950 years forward

legs.note: meant to jump one hour; tethered thereafter to the future

summary: During the Klingon raid on Doctari Alpha, Michael's mother activates the Daedalus suit to jump an hour but lands 950 years ahead, in a galaxy Control has emptied of life. The suit anchors her there, and every trip back pulls her forward again.
conflict: MA's time travel table says only '32nd century'; the 950-year figure gives c. 3186.

title: Red Angel rescues a 2053 congregation

legs.note: relocates a church and its people to Terralysium, 51,000 light years away

summary: To test whether time could be changed, the Red Angel moves a Richmond, Indiana, church congregation out of World War III to the distant planet Terralysium. Their descendants still worship the angel when Discovery arrives in 2257.

title: Red Angel appears to young Spock

legs.note: tells Spock where the runaway Michael is

summary: Gabrielle jumps to Vulcan when young Michael runs away, and shows the boy Spock where to find her. The visions stay with Spock into adulthood.
conflict: The year of Michael's runaway is not given; t is an estimate.

title: Red Angel trapped on Essof IV

legs.note: one of 840 recorded jumps; many 2257 sightings
yanked back through the wormhole when the containment field fails

summary: Discovery and Section 31 bait a trap with Michael's life and catch the Red Angel on Essof IV, revealing Michael's mother. When Control attacks the base, the suit's tether drags Gabrielle back to the future.

title: Probe returns five centuries older

legs.note: launched into a temporal rift left by the Red Angel
comes back modified, hunting for data

summary: A Discovery probe that Pike launches into a temporal rift near Kaminar comes back with a core aged 500 years, rebuilt by someone in the future. It attacks Pike's shuttle and later infects Airiam on Control's behalf.

title: Pike foresees his 2266 accident

legs.note: a vision through the crystal, not physical travel

summary: To claim a Boreth time crystal, Pike touches it and sees the accident that will cripple him saving cadets. He takes the crystal anyway, accepting that future.

title: Michael plants the red bursts

legs.note: first burst
second burst
third burst; stops a Ba'ul culling
fourth burst
fifth burst
returns to open the wormhole

method: Red Angel suit (second suit, Boreth crystal)
summary: In mid-battle, Michael uses a new Red Angel suit to go back and set the red bursts that led Discovery to everything it needed, from the Hiawatha to Po on Xahea. The signals were her doing all along.
conflict: Burst times are placed by their episodes' order; exact dates are unstated (MA: 'various points throughout 2257').

title: Discovery follows Burnham to 3188

legs.note: Michael in the suit
Discovery and crew

summary: To keep the Sphere data out of Control's reach, Michael opens a wormhole and leads Discovery 930 years into the future. She lands a year ahead of the ship, and both stay in the post-Burn 32nd century.

title: Suit sends the seventh signal home

legs.note: a signal sent back in time; the suit then self-destructs

summary: After arriving, Burnham has the suit send a final signal back to Spock, letting her friends know the jump worked, and then destroy itself.

title: Guardian sends Georgiou home and on

legs.note: the Guardian's test: a second chance in her own universe
only seconds pass on Dannus V
sent to an era she can survive; she resurfaces running a station

summary: Dying from being displaced in both time and universe, Georgiou walks through the Guardian's door and relives months as Emperor in 2255. She passes its test and is sent to a period she can live in, which the Section 31 film puts in the early 24th century.
conflict: Destination year given only as 'early 24th century' (film); t=2320 is an estimate.

title: Time bug unmoors Discovery

legs.note: Burnham and Rayner only; the future ship in ruins

summary: A Krenim chronophage planted by Moll and L'ak makes Discovery lurch among points in its own history, from the Klingon war to a ruined 33rd century. Burnham, Rayner and Stamets, the only ones aware of it, find and remove the bug.

title: Kovich unmasked as Agent Daniels

legs.note: not shown on screen; he says he has lived 'many years and many lives'

summary: The Federation official known as Kovich tells Burnham that he is the temporal agent Daniels, 'of the Enterprise and other places', and keeps artifacts from several eras in his office.
conflict: How a 31st-century agent came to 3189 (travel or simply longevity) is unstated.

title: Future Pike shows the alternate 2266

legs.note: an older Pike from the future he tries to avoid
Pike lives through the Balance of Terror crisis in command

summary: An older Pike carrying a Boreth crystal shows his younger self what happens if he dodges his fated accident: war with the Romulans and Spock's death. Pike accepts the path the crystal showed him.

title: La'An to 2022 Toronto

legs.note: a mortally wounded temporal agent appears aboard and hands La'An his device
La'An alone remembers the prime history in a timeline with no Federation
with the alternate timeline's Captain Kirk
returns after Khan is saved; Kirk has died
Agent Ymalay of the DTI thanks her and swears her to secrecy

summary: After a temporal agent dies in her arms, La'An lands in a timeline with no Federation and goes to 2022 with that timeline's Kirk to find what broke history. She has to keep a Romulan agent from killing the boy Khan, preserving her own notorious ancestor.
conflict: The agents' home era is never given; t=2380 is a placeholder for 'the future'.

title: Romulan agent stalks the young Khan

legs.note: sent to kill Khan; stranded 30 years as his rise keeps being pushed back

summary: Sera, a surgically disguised Romulan operative, was sent to stop Khan's rise and so the Federation's future. Rival incursions kept shifting Khan's timeline, and she waited 30 years for her chance in 2022.
conflict: Explains the shift of the Eugenics Wars from the 1990s (TOS) into the 21st century. Origin date is a placeholder.

title: Temporal Wars fought over Khan

legs.note: many factions' incursions; the Eugenics Wars slide into the 21st century

summary: According to Sera, whole Temporal Wars were fought over whether Khan would exist. Their net effect was to push his rise and the Eugenics Wars from the 20th century into the 21st.
conflict: Reconciles TOS 'Space Seed' (Eugenics Wars in the 1990s) with SNW's later dating; dates are placeholders.

title: Boimler and Mariner meet Pike's crew

legs.note: Boimler pulled through the portal
Mariner leaps in after him
portal re-energized with horonium

summary: A dormant portal on Krulmuth-B, first surveyed by Pike's Enterprise, pulls Ensign Boimler back 120 years into his heroes' era, and Mariner jumps after him. Pike's crew recharges the portal to send them home.
conflict: The brief associated this with the Orb of Time, but MA shows only the Krulmuth-B portal; no Orb appears.

title: Enterprise stranded with the dinosaurs

legs.note: a category 10 interstellar squall displaces the ship
rides the blast wave of the Dol'drm homeworld's destruction

summary: A space storm throws the Enterprise back 65 million years, onto a Cretaceous Earth and into a war between Mars' inhabitants and the planet Dol'drm. The ship rides home on the blast that destroys Dol'drm, whose debris formed the asteroid belt and caused the Chicxulub impact.
conflict: Memory Alpha's time travel table says 2261; the episode page gives stardate 2491.5 (2262).

title: Two Uhuras swap across a year

legs.note: entangled Uhuras switch timestreams
time rewinds and each returns; only the two Uhuras remember

method: white hole / black hole pair (a space entity's birth pulses)
summary: Energy from a white hole entangles the Uhura of Pike's final year with herself a year later on Kirk's Enterprise, and the two briefly switch places. In the future Scotty has died, but when the pulses turn out to be a cosmic being's birth, time rewinds and he lives.
conflict: MA's page is a stub (dates from its sidebar); mechanics were checked against published recaps.

title: Q rewrites 2401 as the Confederation

legs.note: a timeline shift, not travel: Q moves the crew into the history he changed

summary: In the middle of a Borg standoff, Q strands Picard's crew in a fascist 2401 ruled by the Confederation of Earth, the result of his own meddling in the past. Only they remember the real history.

title: Q tampers with 2024

legs.note: his deal with Adam Soong derails the Europa mission

summary: The dying Q goes to 2024 and gives Adam Soong a temporary cure for his daughter's condition in return for sabotaging Renée Picard's Europa mission. That creates the Confederation timeline as a test for Picard.
conflict: Q's point of departure is not shown; 2401 is assumed.

title: La Sirena slingshots to 2024

legs.note: with the Confederation's Borg Queen aboard
Q sends Picard, Seven and Raffi home; Rios and the Jurati-Queen stay

method: slingshot effect (Borg Queen-assisted); return by Q
summary: The crew slingshot a captured La Sirena into 2024 to protect Renée Picard's mission. Rios stays in the past with a new family, Jurati merges with the Borg Queen, and Q returns the others to the moment they left.

title: Traveler Wesley recruits Kore

legs.note: origin assumed; Travelers move through space and time

summary: Wesley Crusher, now a Traveler, visits 2024 to offer Kore Soong a place among the beings who guard time and space, and she accepts.
conflict: Wesley's departure time is unknown; the leg's origin is a placeholder.

title: USS Bakersfield caught in a loop

legs.note: loop; its distress call keeps interrupting itself

summary: The Cerritos answers a distress call from the USS Bakersfield, which is stuck in a causality loop.

title: Protostar falls to 2436 Solum

legs.note: a wormhole carries Chakotay's ship into the Vau N'Akat future
original history: Chakotay sends the ship back empty on autopilot

summary: On its maiden mission the Protostar was drawn through a wormhole to 2436, where the Vau N'Akat, blaming the Federation for their civil war, put a living weapon aboard. Chakotay sent the ship back through time, where it lay buried on Tars Lamora until the kids found it.
conflict: Chakotay's original autopilot launch was later superseded by the altered and then repaired history (see protostar-rescue-paradox, ouroboros).

title: Diviner and Vindicator chase the Protostar

legs.note: the Diviner and his Drednok
the Vindicator, a future Asencia, infiltrates Starfleet

summary: A hundred Vau N'Akat agents follow the ship into the anomaly, and only two survive. The Diviner (a future Ilthuran) builds the Tars Lamora mining prison to search for it, and the Vindicator hides inside Starfleet.

title: Distress call from 52 years ahead

legs.note: a signal and black-box footage come through the wormhole, not a traveler

summary: After the Protostar's destruction opens a wormhole, Starfleet receives Chakotay's distress call and black-box recordings from Solum 52 years in the future.

title: Infinity rescue triggers a paradox

legs.note: the Infinity crash-lands
Chakotay and Adreek-Hu escape aboard the ship instead of sending it back empty
the Infinity, rigged as a timeship with an inverse warp field, goes back for Gwyn

summary: Dal's crew takes the Infinity to 2436 to rescue Chakotay and helps him launch the Protostar. Because he and Adreek ride it into the wormhole rather than sending it empty, the ship never reaches Tars Lamora, and Gwyn starts to fade from existence.
sources: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I (episode)

title: Protostar sent back to close the loop

legs.note: USS Voyager-A escorts the ship through Asencia's wormhole and beams the crew off
Voyager-A comes back out near Solum

summary: With the Loom devouring the unraveling timeline, Dal's crew uses Asencia's wormhole generator to send the Protostar back to where they first found it. Dal leaves his combadge on the bridge floor, and the causality loop is closed.
